info.name: Negarify API Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for Negarify Platform - AI Content Generation Platform with Token-Based Economy

## Authentication Flow
1. Request OTP: POST /v1/auth/request-otp
2. Verify OTP: POST /v1/auth/verify-otp (returns token)
3. Use token in Authorization header: Bearer {token}

## Environment Variables
Set `base_url` in Postman environment (e.g., http://localhost:8000/api/v1)

## Test Data
All requests include realistic test data for Iranian market context.

item.name: 01. Authentication (Public)

request.description:
Request OTP code via SMS. Returns request_id (UUID) for OTP verification.

**Phone Format:** Iranian format (09121234567 or +989121234567)

Verify OTP code and receive authentication token.

**Note:** Use request_id from Request OTP response. OTP code is 6 digits sent via SMS.
Resend OTP code to the same phone number using existing request_id.
Logout and invalidate current authentication token. Requires Bearer token.

item.description: Authentication endpoints. Request OTP and Verify OTP are public. Logout requires authentication.

request.description: Get current authenticated user profile with token balance.

item.name: 03. Tokens & Payments

request.description: Get list of available token bundles with real-time prices in Toman. Public endpoint.
Get current USD to Toman exchange rate. Public endpoint.

Purchase token bundle. Creates order and returns Zarinpal payment URL.

**Token Bundle IDs:**
- 1: 100 tokens (Starter)
- 2: 500 tokens (Standard)
- 3: 1000 tokens (Premium)
- 4: 2000 tokens (Ultimate)
Get current user token balance.

query.description: Transaction type: purchase, consume, refund, bonus, adjustment

request.description: Get token transaction history with pagination and filters.
Zarinpal payment gateway callback endpoint. Called by Zarinpal after payment completion. Public endpoint.

item.description: Token and payment management endpoints. Purchase requires authentication, bundles and currency rate are public.

item.name: 05. Gallery & Feed

    "generation_job_id": {{generation_job_id}},

request.description:
Create a gallery post from a completed generation job.

**Visibility:** public, private
**Tags:** Max 10 tags, each max 50 characters
Get detailed information about a gallery post including likes, comments, and metadata.

Delete a gallery post. Only the post owner can delete.
Get list of current user's gallery posts with pagination.
Get curated public feed. Only shows admin-curated posts (images and videos). Has daily view limits for non-admin users.
Copy prompt from a feed post. Returns prompt text if visible.
Copy model information from a feed post. Returns model details if visible.

Remove like from a gallery post.
Add a comment to a gallery post. Use parent_id for nested replies.
Delete a comment. Only comment owner can delete.
Report a gallery post for moderation review.
